meta.scope_note: Pre-registro de la Iteracion 2 (gestor de modelos + Glifo + A/B con ML clasico). Congela set, rejilla, pesos, gestor, brazo B y criterio de exito ANTES de correr, para impedir p-hacking.

sealed_by.convention: v2: sha256(json.dumps({meta sin content_hash/schema, cuerpo sin storage}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))

prereg.title: Pre-Registration — Rosetta Quantum · Iteration 2 (model-manager + Glifo, permanent A/B)
prereg.hypothesis: A model-manager (meta-learner) that picks, per protein and BLIND, the best propagator/variables from protein descriptors — learning from labeled proteins — beats any single fixed method at allosteric-site identification, and crosses significance against the contiguous-pocket spatial null with >=16 proteins.
prereg.set_reference: cleveland_manifest_v2.json (frozen:true); each protein apo->holo with hand-curated ALLOSTERIC ligand (never auto-detected by size) and GT>=5 by number+identity

definitions.graph: Ca contact network, cutoff in {7.5,8.0,8.5,9.0,9.5,10.0} A
definitions.source: active site per src_rule per protein: residues <4.5A of the natural cofactor/substrate present, or catalytic motif by sequence; never memorised numbers unverified
definitions.ground_truth: residues <4.5A of the curated allosteric ligand, mapped to apo by number + residue-type identity
definitions.distal: >6.0 A from source; time windows {(0.5,4),(0.5,8),(0.5,14)}, 16 steps
definitions.spatial_null: contiguous pocket (distal seed + k-1 distal neighbours), NPERM=2000, seed 20260717; paired null on delta = pct_glifo - pct_bare

arm_A_manager.config_space: propagator in {ctqw_bare, ctqw_glifo, diffusion, gnm, anm} x window(3) x weight-bank
arm_A_manager.descriptors: n_residues, fold/domain (InterPro), Glifo feature summary stats, graph spectral gap — NEVER the answer
arm_A_manager.selector: leave-one-protein-out; held-out protein's config chosen by k-NN transfer from nearest-by-descriptor neighbours among the other 15; zero contact with held-out answer

arm_B_ml.purpose: permanent internal A/B in every run: does a classical ML on the same data match/beat the quantum approach?
arm_B_ml.model: regularised logistic regression (C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000, standardised features) — FROZEN, no model/hyperparam change by looking at result
arm_B_ml.features: per-residue classical + Glifo (degree, closeness-to-active, coordination, UniProt binding/active/domain/PTM/motif, ClinVar density, classical propagators diffusion/GNM/betweenness). QUANTUM WALK IS NOT A FEATURE OF ARM B.
arm_B_ml.train_test: strict leave-one-protein-out; score = predicted probability per residue; same metric + spatial null as arm A

success_criteria.primary: in leave-one-out over the 16, the manager-selected config ranks the true allosteric pocket above the spatial null, Fisher-combined p across the 16 < 0.05
success_criteria.secondary: the manager (blind per-protein choice) beats the best fixed single method in (a) mean distal percentile and (b) count of proteins with p<0.05
success_criteria.ab_mandatory: every run reports arm A (quantum manager) vs arm B (classical ML) side by side, same metric and null; published either way
success_criteria.negative_is_valid: a not-yet with 16 is a valid, publishable outcome; it says how many more are needed

guardrails: the manager never sees the answer of the protein it evaluates (strict leave-one-out)
the allosteric ligand is hand-curated and identity-checked, never auto-detected by size (lesson 29 Jul: auto-pick grabs the active site)
sealing by seal() versioned; verify_seals before anchoring; if INVALID nothing is stamped
one actor per tree: the lab (Cowork) runs AND seals; the notary (Code) anchors and publishes
prereg.integrity: This pre-registration is sha256-sealed by the lab (rosettaq-archive/v2) and handed to the notary to OTS-anchor and triple-copy. The seal PRE-DATES the Iteration-2 results. Any deviation is disclosed as a dated amendment, never a silent edit.

storage.policy: triple-copia + ancla OTS; el timestamp PRE-DATA los resultados de la Iteracion 2
